stem: The author’s purpose for including this information in the selection is most likely to —

options.label: A
options.text: describe the history of Europeans traveling to Greenland in order to study the Inughuits

options.label: B
options.text: suggest that Ross’s expedition indirectly caused the destruction of Inughuit culture

options.label: C
options.text: support the claim that the Inughuits have a strong cultural heritage

options.label: D
options.text: emphasize how geographically and culturally isolated the Inughuits once were

visual_elements: The Inughuits thought they were the world’s only inhabitants until an expedition led by the Scottish explorer John Ross came across them in 1818.
